title: Memo: Online Training Webinar
titleZh: 線上訓練研討會備忘錄
paragraphs: Next Tuesday, the sales team will join a training webinar hosted by an outside presenter. The session will cover new product update and customer question handling.

Please mute your microphone as you join the call, and unmute only after the presenter asks for a comment or opinion. A printed handout showing the main slide will be sent by email before the session begins.
This webinar is part of a longer workshop series planned for this quarter. Attendance is required for every sales staff member, so please confirm your seat through the training office by Friday.
If you cannot join the live session, a recording will be shared afterward. Contact the training office for any question.
